about: The Quota's slice cast (era 2, day 41 of the famine winter): one record per speaker, the single source for both design/voice/profiles.json (sound, synth, face, lint rules) and Articulate's design/voice-sheets/quota/*.json (register, region, length, never-words, knowledge). Regenerate both with: node tools/voice/sheets.mjs. Wound, lie and trade are from design/quota/02-HOUSEHOLDS.md; fields marked derived are this director's reading of the design, for the story lead to correct. Speaker keys are a proposal: first names in capitals, as the drafts are expected to use; the 4.1 sample's MOTHER, FATHER and GRANDAD are not aliases, because the Brack table has a mother and a father too. Each writer's `hand` (UI art lead, 2026-10-22) sets how they write; the game reads it through game/engine/ui/lettering/hands.json (node game/engine/tools/handsync.mjs).

peoples.tarn-town: The Upper Town's Tarn: clerks, inspectors, merchants. Finished consonants, a level tune, sentences that close on the verb; Directorate words at work and plain words at home.
peoples.tarn-plain: The plain's Tarn: farmers, cottars, the militia's men. Dropped final g, 'you've not' and 'I'll not', short sentences that fall at the end; field, weather and sack words.
peoples.hesh: The Hesh, Heshen first: a rise at the end of a statement that a Tarn ear hears as a question; Tarnish learned in the barns, full forms ('I do not'); Heshen words for water, rain, the Well and kin when the speaker is moved or afraid.
peoples.half-hesh: Raised in the Upper Town by a Hesh father and a Tarn mother: Tarnish first, the Hesh rise only under stress, Heshen words only at home.
peoples.directorate: The People's Directorate's officers: written Arlen said aloud: passives, figures, titles, the word 'comrade' used as a stop.

slurs.about: The invented slurs of 01-WORLD.md. Spoken in full by a character with a history and someone who hears it; never by the narrator, the interface or the read-back's own voice (VOICE-BIBLE 11.5).
